Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
...Boo!
Whoa!? ...Oh, it's just you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Don't give me 'just you.' Where's the fun in it if you don't act a little more surprised？
Wait, were you hiding there the whole time？
You were taking forever to spot me, so I got tired of waiting and came out. Hehe.
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. ...You know, something seems a little different about you today.
Really？ Pretty sure I'm the same as always.
Hmm... Maybe it's just me, then.
Why？
I just have this feeling something out of the ordinary's gonna happen. Maybe that's making everything around me look special.
(▲小早川＊▲'s running late...)
Kobayakawa
Sorry for the wait!
Hey. You're in pretty high spirits for someone who's late.
I went all out getting ready and lost track of time. Cut me some slack, okay？
Yes, yes.
Hehe, that's more like it.
(Still no sign of ▲小早川＊▲...)
Kobayakawa
Hey. You've been checking out other girls this whole time, haven't you？
▲小早川＊▲... Come on, no I wasn't. I was looking for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Really？ Then can you keep your eyes just on me the whole time？
Alright, then...
Hey, don't take it so literally... No glaring at me!
(Make up your mind...)
▲小早川＊▲. Did I keep you waiting？
Kobayakawa
I just got here too. Waiting around for my boyfriend isn't so bad once in a while.
Is that how it is？
Yeah, it gives me time to think about stuff. Like what we're gonna talk about today...
Guess I can take my time next time, too.
I said once in a while! And showing up late on purpose is totally off-limits.
Okay, I know.
Yo, ▲Kobayaka＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Hehe. It's date time!
You're pretty hyped up today, aren't you？
Well, it looks like my boyfriend worked really hard planning our date. Maybe that's why.
Way to put the pressure on.
I've got high hopes! Don't let me down.
Kobayakawa
Oh, there you are. ...Jeez, I've been looking all over for you.
Sorry. It's so crowded, ● couldn't find you either, ▲小早川＊▲.
...You're supposed to find me right away.
▲小早川＊▲？
It's nothing. Come on, let's go.
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
Jeez, what took you so long!
Huh？ ...I'm not late, though.
Yeah, I know, but... there was a couple right next to me being all lovey-dovey until a second ago...
Don't tell me that made you want to do it too...
Huh？ As if! It was just awkward having them flaunt it in front of me. You're such an idiot.
Kobayakawa
You. Are. Late!
▲小早川＊▲. Sorry, sorry.
Don't give me 'sorry.' Some guy came up and talked to me because you were late.
What!? Was he hitting on you？
Probably, yeah. He wasn't pushy, so it's fine, but if you're gonna get that worked up, don't be late in the first place.
You're right. Got it.
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
...What's wrong？
You... actually stand out more than I thought. I can spot you right away, even from a distance.
Oh yeah？ You mean that in a good way, right？
Huh？ Um... In that case, let's say in a bad way.
(...'In that case'？)
Kobayakawa
Want to go grab something to drink first？
Yeah, sure.
Kobayakawa
Hey, I'm getting thirsty.
Let's go get something to drink, then.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Let's stop for a drink for a bit. Okay？
Yeah, go ahead.
How about here？
Kobayakawa
By the way, do you remember last Valentine's Day？
Last Valentine's... You mean the one ● spent with you？
Yeah. Remember, I gave you chocolate.
Of course I remember...
Kobayakawa
Hehe.
Hm？
Oh, sorry. Just laughing at a memory. From White Day.
White Day, huh...
Yeah. Remember, you got me something in return.
Kobayakawa
I keep thinking back to Christmas...
Eh？
The Christmas I spent with you.
Oh, right. Yeah...
Hard to forget, isn't it？
Kobayakawa
My birthday...
What!? ...Wait, that's not today, right？
Hm？ Oh, obviously not. That's not what I meant, I was just thinking back to it.
Oh. Way to confuse me.
Well, I can't help thinking back on it sometimes. How you celebrated it with me.
Let me see...
Kobayakawa
Kind of random, I know, but if there's anything you want for your birthday, I'm listening.
You say that, but don't you already have something in mind？
...Not really.
Uh-huh. Well, alright.
It's just, I want you to like it even more than last time, so I'm doing some research. Do you remember last time？
Of course I remember.
Kobayakawa
Do you remember our last anniversary？
Anniversary... You mean of when you and ● started going out？
Yeah, we celebrated it together, remember？
Yeah, of course I remember.
Hehe, thought so.
You said it ticked you off how calm ● was.
You said it was my fault for giving my girlfriend the wrong idea.
You said ▲小早川＊▲ could be trusted from the start
You said if ● picked it, you wouldn't be disappointed
You said you'd accept it since you had no choice
You said you were looking forward to how I'd give it to you
You said, "If I start liking Christmas even more..."
You said you never know what to say when it counts
You said you'd try being a little more honest
You asked if I'd celebrate with you next year too
You said you hoped your next birthday would be fun too
You said the more fun it is, the harder it is to say goodbye
You asked if I wasn't going to do it before you went home...
You said it's tough having a boyfriend who gets lonely easily
You asked me for a favor in return for celebrating
You said we'd see each other tomorrow and forever after
You said you needed words too, not just a present
You said we're a couple so there's nothing to be shy about
Kobayakawa
Of course you do. My boyfriend's always thinking about me, right？
When you put it like that, it's kind of embarrassing.
Kobayakawa
Hmm, I see. Guess that means I haven't shown you nearly enough love yet.
Can't be helped. Guess I'll just have to give you an extra dose of love today.
(Guess I got it wrong... At least she isn't mad.)
Kobayakawa
Hey... What would you do if I said I wanted to stay by your side forever？
Huh... ● want to stay with you too, though.
...Yeah, we both feel the same way. Still, I know I'm asking the impossible. Sorry for being selfish.
With me, ● don't mind if you're a little selfish.
Kobayakawa
We've gone to so many places on our dates together, haven't we？
Yeah, we have. Where do you want to go next？
Right here is fine.
Here？
Yeah, right next to you. As long as I can be here, I don't need anything else.
Kobayakawa
I wish time would just stop right now, just for the two of us.
We still have plenty of time together today, don't we？
Yeah, but it'll end eventually. I want it to last forever.
Even when today ends, we can just go on another date. I'll go out with you as many times as you want.
Kobayakawa
...Is there something wrong with my hand？
What's wrong？
It wants to hold yours even tighter. Looks like it doesn't want to let go.
Then that's fine. Looks like ● have the same problem. Here.
Kobayakawa
You know, sometimes I get jealous of cats.
Because they get to live carefree lives？
No. Because they can just purr and cuddle up to the person they love for as long as they want.
Well... you don't have to be a cat to be spoiled like that, right？
Kobayakawa
Doesn't it feel like I'm always the one leaning on you？
You think so？ You can lean on me even more if you want.
That's not what I mean. ...I just wish you'd lean on me once in a while.
●？ Yeah, maybe that wouldn't be so bad...
Kobayakawa
Hey, after a date, when it's time to say goodbye, sometimes I get really anxious. Is that weird？
Is ● making you feel that way？
No, it's not that. It's not, just... can I hold your hand right now？
Yeah, sure. Until you don't feel anxious anymore.
▲小早川＊▲, what's wrong？ You've been quiet for a while.
Kobayakawa
I just wanted to look at your profile. No real reason.
●'s？ Then maybe ●'ll return the favor.
Then I won't be able to see your side profile. No way. Come on, face forward.
Eh！？
Kobayakawa
Going on a date on a special day really is nice.
Wait, is today a special day？
Yeah. A day with a special date makes it a special day. Today's date feels a little different, after all.
I see... If you feel that way, I'm glad.
Kobayakawa
...I think I might feel a little feverish.
Wait, did you catch a cold！？
Probably not... I'm just having so much fun today, and my heart's racing... I'm sure that's why.
Haha. Then you're fine. Same goes for ●.
Kobayakawa
We still have plenty of time to spend together after this, right？
Yeah. I wanted to take our time on today's date.
This might be nice once in a while. Doing things like this.
Going on a date without worrying about the time is great, isn't it？
Kobayakawa
Guess we've caught our breath for now.
Today's only just getting started, you know？
I know, I know. I'm not gonna go home halfway through. Hehe.
Haha, don't scare me like that.
Kobayakawa
We can still stay together for a while today, right？
We've got plenty of time.
Hehe, yes!
Haha, someone's excited.
Kobayakawa
We still have plenty of time left, right？
We've got a ton lined up for today!
Yeah, yeah. Just don't get too carried away and hurt yourself.
What is ●, a kid...？
Kobayakawa
What are we doing after this？
Maybe we can take it easy for a bit. Since we have time.
Hmm, I'll leave it to you then. Lead the way.
Understood.
Kobayakawa
Not having to worry about the time is the best.
Yeah, we've still got plenty of time today.
I wish it could always be like this...
Hm？
Kobayakawa
Hey, want to take a little break？
Did you get tired？
Just a little.
All right, let's do that.
Kobayakawa
How much longer are we going to walk？
Sorry, are you tired？
Pretty much. Try to notice without me having to tell you.
You're right. Let's rest for a bit.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Aren't you tired？
● feel fine... Oh, sorry. We've been walking nonstop, so you must be tired.
Just a bit.
All right, let's take a break then.
Kobayakawa
Hey, want to rest for a bit？
Yeah, let's take a break around here.
Yeah. Though walking around is part of the fun of a date, too.
Kobayakawa
Your girlfriend is getting tired over here, you know？
Oh, right.
Feels like we're out walking for exercise.
Then let's find somewhere to rest a bit.
Kobayakawa
Hey, can we take a quick break？
Did you get tired？
Just a little. I figured it'd be nice to take it easy.
Good point. Let's catch our breath.
Kobayakawa
Hey, we've been going on a lot of dates lately, haven't we？
Now that you mention it, maybe we have.
Right？ Looking back on it, we go out all the time.
That much？
Yes, that much. What, have you still not had enough dates？
If it doesn't feel like a lot to me, maybe I haven't had enough. Haha.
You've got it bad. Though I guess I'm no different for going along with it... Hehe.
Kobayakawa
Feels like we haven't gone on many dates lately.
Really？ ...Maybe you're right. I need to make more time for us to go out.
I appreciate that, but you don't have to push yourself.
Eh？
I want to go on dates, sure, but quantity isn't everything.
Well, I guess that's true.
We still get to have fun dates like today, so that's plenty for me.
Kobayakawa
You've been asking me to meet up a lot lately, haven't you？
Wait... Is it bothering you？
Of course not. That's not what I meant at all.
I was just wondering if you really wanted to be with me that much.
Well... maybe I do.
Hehe, how honest. So you're head over heels for me, huh.
When you put it like that... well, you're not wrong.
Kobayakawa
You haven't been calling me out much lately, have you？
Uh... Wait, are you mad？
...Hehe. Did I scare you？
Of course you did.
Like I'd actually get mad over something like that.
You do？
I'm serious. Besides, you're taking me on dates like this. I'm plenty satisfied.
Kobayakawa
You've been pretty touchy-feely lately, haven't you.
...Have I？ Does it bother you？
No. Actually, when you stroke my hair or touch me gently, it makes me feel safe.
I see, that's good.
So, you know.
Hm？
If you don't mind, I'm fine keeping things just like this.
(She's being awfully honest... It's cute, though.)
Kobayakawa
...Got a minute？
What's wrong？ Your face is bright red.
Um, have you been holding back lately？
Holding back on what？
Don't make me spell it out. Like... touching me, and stuff.
...Oh, right. I just figured you wouldn't want me being all over you.
...I know you're just being considerate, but you don't have to worry so much about it.
Kobayakawa
...Hehe.
What are you grinning about？
I am not grinning.
You do？
Are you gonna keep pushing it？ Fine, then... I won't kiss you anymore.
What？ Come on...
We've been doing it a lot lately, anyway. Just kidding, though.
Kobayakawa
Wait... do you think you're being considerate or something？
What are you talking about？
When I'm right here next to you like this, don't you... want to kiss me？
Oh, right... I guess we haven't kissed much lately.
Even I want to sometimes... Ugh, seriously, are you really making your girlfriend say this？
...Sorry.
I'm glad you treat me with care, but... you know.
Kobayakawa
Hey, am I really that good of a cook...？
I think so. Why？
You always say my food's delicious, and that makes me happy, but I'm really not that confident.
Don't worry. ● think it tastes great, so you can be confident!
...Hehe, why do you sound so high and mighty？
Kobayakawa
I'm really not that good at cooking after all, huh.
Where'd that come from all of a sudden？
'Cause I feel like you're always criticizing it.
It's not really criticism... More just personal taste... Sorry, does it bother you？
No, not at all. Actually, it kinda makes me happy.
It makes you happy？
Yeah, I'm glad you can be that honest with me about it.
Kobayakawa
You really like taking creepshots, huh.
What！？
Oh, my mistake. You like taking pictures, huh.
Hehe, it's not like I mind. It actually makes me kinda happy.
Kobayakawa
You don't take many pictures, do you？ Even though you have a camera.
Huh, I guess not？ Do you want me to take more？
That's not what I said. I just thought maybe you were holding back for my sake.
That's not it, but...
Well, good. You hold back like that sometimes, you know.
Kobayakawa
Do you like the way I dress？
Why？
You compliment me every time we go on a date, so I thought maybe you were just being nice.
Not at all. It's very you, ▲小早川＊▲, and it always looks good on you.
I see. ...Well, good.
I didn't realize you were worried about that.
Well, yeah. Of course I want my boyfriend to like how I dress.
Kobayakawa
I wonder if my sense of style is getting any better.
Huh, why do you ask？
'Cause you give me feedback on it a lot.
Sorry, that must be a pain.
Well, maybe a little, but I don't mind. When you tell me what you think, it makes the effort feel worth it.
Hearing you say that kinda makes me happy.
Really？ Then I'm glad.
Kobayakawa
You send me a lot of messages, huh.
Is it a little too much？
No, it makes me happy. That's just proof of how much you like me, right？
Well... When you put it like that, it's kinda embarrassing.
Hehe.
Besides, ● always look forward to getting replies from you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh, yeah？ That's a little bit of pressure.
Just write like you always do. That's what makes it you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Haven't you been sending fewer messages lately？
Sorry. ...It's not like I'm doing it on purpose, though.
No, it's fine. I'm not blaming you or anything.
Really？
I'm not some kid who's just happy to get a ton of messages, you know.
● don't think more is automatically better either, though.
Right？ As long as your heart's in each one, that's enough for me.
Kobayakawa
I really have it pretty good, huh. Thanks to you.
You're exaggerating. I don't think I do anything that special.
All kinds of things... even the little stuff. Like when we eat together, you always know what I like.
Well, I want us to enjoy eating together.
Hehe, you make it sound so easy. You're not pushing yourself, are you？
I'm not pushing myself at all.
I see... I'm glad I have such a sweet boyfriend.
Kobayakawa
Lately, you're kind of like that thing sometimes, aren't you.
That thing？
How do I put it... an animal？ A beast？
What's with that...
Well, you can get kind of pushy with the affection...
Uh... I'm sorry...
Just keep it in moderation. So far, I really don't mind it.
Kobayakawa
Maybe that's one of the reasons I love you...
Hm？ Love... You mean a reason why you love ●？
Obviously! Don't make me spell it out, dummy.
Kobayakawa
That right there. That part of you is no good, either.
No good？ Um...
Not good at all. Because of that, I love you way too much.
Ah... Wait, what do you mean by...
Dummy, don't make me explain it.
Kobayakawa
Hey.
What？
I love you.
Eh？
That side of you is another thing I really love... Hehe.
Kobayakawa
Yeah, taking all of that together, I think... I really love you.
Stay by my side forever, okay？ ...Please.
Kobayakawa
No matter how I look at it, this is definitely your fault.
●？ For what？
Doing stuff like that... You're basically seducing me.
Seducing you！？
Wha— Not in a weird way! ...I just mean you're making me fall for you.
Kobayakawa
Hey, are you... crazy about me, too？
What's with the sudden question？
Just answer me. I was wondering if you're as crazy about me as I am about you.
Well... I mean...
Give me a straight answer... Well, with your face that red, I guess it's obvious anyway.
Kobayakawa
It's no use. No matter what I think about... I just love you.
I was the one who was happy...
No way, I love you way more.
Is that so？
I really do. So... don't ever stop liking me, okay？
Kobayakawa
Being like that is why I love you.
Eh！？
I just do! You made me say that much, so you're satisfied now, right...？
Kobayakawa
I feel a little weird right now.
What's wrong？ Are you not feeling well？
Not like that! Just talking like this with you...
Hm？
I think I might like you even more now.
Kobayakawa
Hey, is it really okay to have this much fun... and be this happy？ I had such a great time today. I really appreciate it, you know.
Kobayakawa
...Honestly, I had so much fun on our date today I don't even know what to say. I might've fallen for you all over again.
Kobayakawa
My thoughts on today's date... It made me love you way, way more. Really, you know？ I really mean it.
Kobayakawa
Today's date was... just amazing. It feels like a memory I'll never forget.
Kobayakawa
...Am I grinning again？ Well, obviously I am after having that much fun on a date. I'm pretty moved right now.
Kobayakawa
I don't think I'll ever forget today. That's how special a date it was. Thanks.
Kobayakawa
You tried a lot harder than usual today, didn't you？ I notice things like that, so really, thanks.
Kobayakawa
Today's a special day, right？ I wanted to do something a bit more special together. Didn't you feel the same way？
Kobayakawa
Thanks. Today turned into a really special date. I want to treasure memories like this.
What's wrong？ Is something up？
Kobayakawa
It's not like this is goodbye forever, so why don't I want to leave？ I wonder what's gotten into me...
●I mean, if we could stay together forever, I'd love to, but...
Hey, so... just for a little longer...
What's wrong？
Kobayakawa
Um... yeah... Come a little closer.
Hehe, did I surprise you？ A little goodbye... you know. See ya.
Kobayakawa
...Guess that's it for today. Yeah, I had fun. See you later.
Kobayakawa
Thanks. ...Can't just not go home, I guess. See you later.
Kobayakawa
Just a little longer... ...No, I'm being selfish. Bye-bye.
Kobayakawa
...Okay, time's up. See ya.
Kobayakawa
Just a little more before we go... ...Guess it can't be helped. See ya.
Kobayakawa
Well, see you later. Sorry for being selfish at the end.
Kobayakawa
It's starting to get dark. I wonder if they'll turn the lights on soon？
Yeah. ...By the way, aren't you cold？
Just a little. But I'm fine... *achoo*... Hehe.
See？ Even though it's spring, the nights are still cold, so don't tough it out too much.
...Okay. Then maybe I'll ask you for a favor.
A favor？
Yeah. Like this...
Whoa!?
Hey, don't back away. It's better this way, right？
...It's a little embarrassing, though.
What's the big deal？ All the other couples are doing the same thing anyway.
True... All right. If we don't hurry, someone's gonna take the good spots to see the cherry blossoms.
Yep, let's go.
Kobayakawa
Good thing a spot with a nice view was open.
It wasn't just open—I had to scramble to save it for us, you know.
Hehe, thanks▼
...Looking at them like this, they give off a totally different vibe than during the day.
Definitely. It's almost magical.
I don't want to sum it up with a cliché like that... ...Still, I can't think of a better way to put it.
They're pretty, sure, but...
Hm? Is something wrong?
They only stay in bloom for such a short time. Just when you think they've opened, they're already falling.
True... Still, I'm sure they'll bloom just as nicely again next year.
Next year, huh... I wonder if we'll be able to come back... together...
Maybe it's because I brought up the petals falling... I think I just made myself anxious.
You don't need to worry about that.
Yeah, I know. I know that.
Still... hold me tight for a second.
Yeah.
...Being like this calms me down.
Let's come see the cherry blossoms next year, too.
Only next year...？
Not just next year. Every year after that, too.
Yeah. Next year, the year after, and forever after that... It's a promise.
Kobayakawa
The trees around the shrine have really changed color. ...Oh, there are ginkgo nuts on the ground.
Did you ever pick up ginkgo nuts when you were little？
All the time. That smell, though.
Right, right. Even your hands end up smelling like them.
Well, that's just another little reminder that it's autumn.
Smelling that stink？
N-o! I mean the act of picking them up.
Haha, I guess so.
When I was little, I'd get completely absorbed in picking them up. And before I knew it, the sun would be sinking right between those trees.
The sunset, huh... Bet that was pretty.
Back then, I'd stand here just like this, watching through the trees as the town turned bright red... until it got pitch dark.
You never really forget childhood memories like that, do you. It's like they're burned into your mind.
Yeah. No matter how much the town changes, this sunset hasn't changed a bit since back then. It's the exact same sunset from my memories.
Kobayakawa
Wow... The autumn leaves look nice lit up, too. I didn't realize they'd be this vivid...
When I was little, the shrine grounds here used to get pitch dark once the sun went down.
Were you scared？
Not really... No, there's no point lying to you, is there.
I was terrified. It felt like I was the only person left behind in the whole world...
When my dad came to get me, his hand was so big and warm... I remember how safe it made me feel.
...It's cold.
The wind's picking up, so let's get something warm to drink. They're handing out amazake over there.
Yeah, let's go. ...Hey, your hand.
Oh, right.
Hehe.
I guess ● isn't much of a substitute for your dad, though.
Still, I don't mind it.
My dad used to take my hand when I was little. And now you're the one doing it, huh... Hehe.
Your hand's gotten cold, ▲小早川＊▲.
Being like this, I can feel your warmth... It's nice and warm.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Got a second？
Hm？
Aren't there a lot of couples here today？
Yeah. It was in a magazine as a recommended movie for couples, too. ...Does that bother you？
Why？
I just thought you might not like that kind of movie, ▲小早川＊▲.
I only hate forced love scenes that don't serve any purpose in the story.
As long as it's good, I don't really care about the genre.
Gotcha. Well, I hope today's is a good one.
Yeah. I'll just enjoy it without expecting too much.
Kobayakawa
...Hey. Will you... hold my hand...？
...Yeah, sure.
(▲小早川＊▲... Is she crying？)
▲小早川＊▲, are you okay？ I have a handkerchief if you need it...
...Thanks. That was a really good movie.
Yeah. I didn't expect it to move you that much, though, ▲小早川＊▲.
During the first half, I figured it was just another typical story.
But then that scene right before the climax. The hero breaks up with the heroine so he won't drag her into danger, right？
Yeah, that was one of the best scenes.
Even though she's the person he loves most, and their feelings finally reached each other... Even so... they part ways. That's just too sad.
I don't even want to imagine losing the place where I finally belong. I'd much rather jump into danger together than go through that.
(▲小早川＊▲... She really got that emotionally invested in it.)
Don't worry. ● would never go off somewhere and leave you behind, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Really？
Really. Do you think ● would ever make you feel lonely like that, ▲小早川＊▲？
You promise, right？ You better never do anything dangerous all on your own, okay？
You don't have to stress over it that much. I won't.
...Good. Hehe, I should be happy, but I feel like I'm gonna cry.
Kobayakawa
Sigh... Now I'm getting nervous. The tournament's starting any minute now, right？
The couples tournament, yeah. Come on, loosen up a bit.
...You say that, but didn't you forget to change your shoes？
Oh, shoot.
Honestly... Guess we're in the same boat.
We came here on a whim, but now that we're actually doing it, it really makes you nervous.
It'll be a problem if you're that nervous. I'm counting on my boyfriend to cover for all of my mistakes.
Huh？ ● gotta cover for you...？
Hehe, obviously, right？
...I'll do my best.
Announcement
We will now begin the first round of the tournament.
Alright... Time for my first throw. Hup.
A ball that heavy is way too much for you, ▲小早川＊▲. You should pick a lighter one...
